ticket.title: Login location picker ignores the configured number of locations to load
ticket.text:
Login location picker ignores the configured number of locations to load

## Description

The login app has two settings for the location picker on the login screen: one to control how many locations are fetched at a time (`chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest`) and one to control how many are shown (`chooseLocation.numberToShow`). Neither setting actually does anything. The picker always fetches 50 locations per request regardless of what an implementation configures, so changing these values in a distro config has no effect.

`numberToShow` is left over from an older fixed-length location list and no longer has a meaningful equivalent now that the picker uses infinite scroll, so keeping it in the config only misleads implementers.

## Acceptance criteria

- When `chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest` is set in config, the login location picker uses that value for each batch of locations it fetches and for when it loads more on scroll.
- When it isn't set, the picker keeps its current default behaviour.
- `chooseLocation.numberToShow` is no longer offered as a config option. Implementations that still set it see at most a standard "unknown config key" warning, with no other change in behaviour.
- No visible UI changes to the login screen.
- Covered by a test that verifies the configured value reaches the location picker.

understanding.intent: Allow the login location picker to respect the configured batch size for fetching locations and remove the obsolete number-to-show configuration option.

criteria.text: When chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest is configured, the login location picker fetches that specified number of locations in each request initially and when scrolling for more.
criteria.quote: When chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest is set in config, the login location picker uses that value for each batch of locations it fetches and for when it loads more on scroll.

criteria.text: When chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest is not configured, the login location picker retains its default batch fetch behavior of 50 locations per request.
criteria.quote: When it isn't set, the picker keeps its current default behaviour.

criteria.text: The chooseLocation.numberToShow configuration key is deprecated/removed so that setting it causes at most a standard unknown config key warning and does not alter picker behavior.

criteria.text: The login screen layout and visual appearance remain unchanged.
criteria.quote: No visible UI changes to the login screen.

criteria.text: An automated test verifies that the configured locationsPerRequest value properly passes to the location picker.
criteria.quote: Covered by a test that verifies the configured value reaches the location picker.

understanding.domain_reason: Configuring location loading in the login screen is a standard part of the OpenMRS 3 app shell and authentication flow.
understanding.reason: Testers can configure different values for chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest and observe network calls and loaded items in the location picker on the login screen.
